title: Federal Reserve cuts rates by a quarter point
summary: The Fed lowered its benchmark rate by 25 basis points after its July meeting.
content: Federal Reserve officials voted to reduce the federal funds target range by one quarter percentage point. Chair Elena Morris cited softer inflation and slower hiring while saying future moves would depend on economic data.

title: European Central Bank leaves interest rates unchanged
summary: ECB policymakers held their deposit rate steady at the July meeting.
content: The European Central Bank kept its key deposit rate unchanged. President Marta Klein said euro-area inflation remains above target and officials need more evidence before considering a reduction.

title: Evacuations ordered as Canyon Fire spreads near Sacramento
summary: California officials ordered residents to leave three communities threatened by the Canyon Fire.
content: The Canyon Fire expanded to 18,000 acres north of Sacramento as dry winds pushed flames toward homes. County officials issued mandatory evacuation orders and opened shelters at two schools.

title: Hurricane Iris approaches Florida Gulf Coast
summary: Forecasters expect Hurricane Iris to make landfall near Tampa late Friday.
content: Hurricane Iris strengthened over the Gulf of Mexico and prompted evacuation orders in low-lying Florida counties. The National Hurricane Center warned of storm surge and destructive coastal winds.

title: US expands export restrictions on Nvidia AI chips
summary: New Commerce Department rules limit shipments of advanced Nvidia processors to China.
content: The Commerce Department announced expanded licensing requirements for Nvidia artificial-intelligence accelerators. The restrictions cover modified chips previously designed to fall below existing performance thresholds.

title: Apple introduces new iPhone with upgraded camera
summary: Apple unveiled its latest iPhone line during a product event in California.
content: Apple announced a new iPhone featuring a larger camera sensor, a faster mobile processor and longer battery life. The devices will become available for preorder Friday and reach stores next week.

title: NASA delays Mars sample-return launch
summary: NASA moved the planned Mars sample-return launch to 2031 after a technical review.
content: NASA postponed its Mars sample-return mission after engineers identified mass and heat-shield problems in the ascent vehicle. The agency will redesign the spacecraft before targeting a 2031 launch window.

title: Japanese rover lands near Moon's south pole
summary: The Kaguya Two rover completed a controlled lunar landing and began surface checks.
content: Japan's space agency confirmed that the Kaguya Two robotic rover landed near the lunar south pole. Controllers received telemetry and prepared the vehicle to study ice-bearing soil over a fourteen-day mission.

title: Fed lowers borrowing costs as inflation cools
summary: US central bankers approved a 0.25 percentage-point rate reduction.
content: At the conclusion of its July policy meeting, the Federal Reserve cut the benchmark federal funds rate by 25 basis points. Officials pointed to easing price pressures and moderation in the labor market.

title: ECB pauses and keeps deposit rate steady
summary: The euro-zone central bank made no change to rates while inflation remains persistent.
content: European Central Bank governors voted to maintain current borrowing costs at their July gathering. Marta Klein said policymakers were not yet confident that inflation would return sustainably to two percent.

title: Canyon Fire forces thousands from Northern California homes
summary: The wildfire north of Sacramento grew rapidly under strong winds.
content: More than 6,000 residents were told to evacuate as the Canyon Fire burned 18,000 acres. Fire crews protected neighborhoods while emergency shelters opened in the Sacramento region.

title: Florida counties evacuate before Hurricane Iris landfall
summary: Storm-surge warnings cover the Tampa Bay coastline as Iris advances.
content: Authorities ordered residents of vulnerable coastal zones to leave before Hurricane Iris reaches Florida's Gulf Coast. Forecasters predict landfall near Tampa with dangerous surge late Friday.

title: Commerce Department tightens China limits for Nvidia processors
summary: Washington added licensing rules for advanced artificial-intelligence chips.
content: US officials expanded semiconductor export controls to include lower-performance Nvidia AI accelerators created for China. Nvidia said the licensing requirement could affect future sales in the market.

title: New iPhone lineup adds faster chip and larger image sensor
summary: Apple's California launch event focused on photography and battery improvements.
content: The latest Apple iPhone models use a new mobile processor and upgraded camera hardware. Preorders open Friday, with retail availability scheduled for the following week.

title: Technical problems push Mars sample mission to 2031
summary: NASA will redesign the ascent craft and heat shield before launching.
content: A NASA review found weight and thermal-control problems in hardware intended to retrieve samples from Mars. The space agency abandoned the earlier launch date and set a new target of 2031.

title: Kaguya Two begins work after successful lunar touchdown
summary: Japan's robotic explorer transmitted data from the Moon's south polar region.
content: The Japanese Kaguya Two rover achieved a controlled landing near the lunar south pole. Mission teams confirmed healthy telemetry before beginning a two-week investigation of potentially icy soil.

title: US central bank approves 25-basis-point rate cut
summary: The Federal Reserve responded to cooler prices and weaker job growth.
content: Federal Reserve policymakers reduced their target interest-rate range by 25 basis points in July. Chair Elena Morris described the decision as a response to declining inflation and a cooling employment market.

title: Euro-area rates remain on hold after ECB decision
summary: Officials declined to cut borrowing costs at their latest policy meeting.
content: The ECB maintained its deposit facility rate and warned that underlying inflation was still elevated. President Marta Klein said a future cut was possible but not guaranteed by current forecasts.

title: Crews battle 18,000-acre Canyon Fire north of Sacramento
summary: Mandatory evacuation zones expanded as the California blaze threatened communities.
content: Wind-driven flames from the Canyon Fire prompted expanded evacuation orders around three Northern California towns. Firefighters reported 18,000 acres burned and directed displaced residents to school shelters.

title: Iris strengthens ahead of expected Tampa-area strike
summary: The hurricane could bring severe winds and coastal flooding to western Florida.
content: The National Hurricane Center expects Iris to cross the Florida Gulf Coast near Tampa late Friday. Officials expanded evacuation zones because of projected storm surge in low-lying communities.

title: Nvidia China sales face broader US licensing requirements
summary: Revised export controls target advanced data-center chips and modified variants.
content: New Commerce Department rules require approval before Nvidia can ship several AI processors to Chinese customers. The update closes performance-threshold exceptions used by specially modified accelerators.

title: Apple opens preorders for camera-focused iPhone models
summary: The newly announced phones promise better photos, speed and battery life.
content: Following its product presentation, Apple said customers can preorder the new iPhone Friday. The phones include an upgraded image sensor, a faster processor and efficiency improvements for longer use.

title: NASA redesigns sample-return spacecraft after Mars delay
summary: Engineering concerns forced the agency to abandon its previous launch schedule.
content: The Mars sample-return program will not launch until at least 2031, NASA said. Engineers must reduce spacecraft mass and revise a heat shield and ascent vehicle following an independent technical assessment.

title: Japan confirms south-pole landing of Kaguya Two lunar rover
summary: Controllers are preparing the robot for a two-week search for frozen water.
content: Japan's space agency received signals confirming Kaguya Two safely reached the Moon. The rover landed near the south pole and will examine surface material for signs of water ice.
